newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian bank HBOR signs for 700 mln ATS Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Croatian bank HBOR signs for 700 mln ATS Eurobond.

text.p: The Croatian state bank for reconstruction and development (HBOR) on Monday signed an agreement with 13 foreign banks to issue a 700 million Austrian schilling Eurobond, state news agency Hina said.
The five-year bond, paying an annual coupon of 5.625 percent, was guaranteed by the Croatian government. It was arranged by Austria's Creditanstalt Bankverein as a lead manager.
HINA quoted HBOR's head Anton Kovacev as saying the interest rate was very favourable. He also said the funds should be on HBOR accounts as early as next week.
They will be channelled into long-term loans for tourism projects, the agency said.

The agreement was signed on the island of Brac near the Adriatic port of Split, following roadshows in Vienna and Frankfurt. The bond was listed on the Luxembourg and Vienna bourses. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
